div.div: Phases run in order, each gating the next. Phase 0–1 establish a verified spec; 2–3 design it; 4–5 build with author-separated TDD behind an automated gate; 6–8 review, document, and ship; Phase 9 codifies learnings that the next cycle’s research reads back — closing the compound loop.
